args.message: Address review: name amount units and reject negative entries

args.body: Renamed `amt` to `amount_cents` in the helper signature and returned value on `entry-helper`. Added coverage for the explicit parameter name and keyword calls. Local validation: `python -m pytest -q` — 7 passed. The push API acknowledged the update, but repository-content reads are returning empty results, so I could not independently verify the remote contents.

Added a guard that raises `ValueError` when `amount_cents < 0`; zero and positive amounts remain accepted. Added negative-amount and non-negative boundary tests. Local validation: `python -m pytest -q` — 7 passed. The push API acknowledged the update to `entry-helper`, but repository-content reads are returning empty results, so I could not independently verify the remote contents.
